instruction: Install the extension from the zip file at /home/user/Desktop/ into Chrome and ensure it has a popup interface configured.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: This task verifies that the extension has a popup configured in manifest.json by checking for the 'default_popup' field in the 'action' section. The manifest contains 'default_popup': 'hello.html'.
